question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` on `ContextEngine.assemble` plus the new SDK token-budget helper exports as a stable public plugin contract now, or fold this signal into the broader assemble metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: The diff is mechanically plausible, but it expands the public plugin SDK/context-engine API while related assemble metadata design remains open, so automation cannot choose the permanent contract boundary.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve this optional token-headroom signal now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live long-session context-engine proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into RFC Metadata Work
options.body: Pause this branch and handle token counts together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Avoid new SDK helper exports until maintainers decide which token-budget helpers are stable for plugin authors.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve this optional token-headroom signal now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live long-session context-engine proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is assigned and has the most direct recent history on the same context-engine budgeting path.
